method.boundary: Native Linux Flutter renderToPng(source,pixelRatio:1); Stopwatch inside release app on the host under a private Xvfb display. App startup, warm-ups, IPC, admission and reporting excluded.
method.admission: A call completes only when it returns without error and its output passes mechanical admission after the clock stops: SVG must parse to an svg root with positive size; PNG must have a PNG signature and positive dimensions; terminal text must be non-empty after removing control sequences. Error placeholders (aria-roledescription="error"), outputs led by a renderer error phrase absent from the source, and terminal text that only echoes the source are failures. No drawing meaning is judged and outputs are not retained.
